name: Batch-Cook Plant-Based Staples
equipment: A large pot, sheet pan, and several containers
instructions: Cook a big batch of grains (rice, quinoa, farro) and legumes (lentils, chickpeas) at the start of the week -- they are the base of most plant-based meals.
Roast a full sheet pan of mixed vegetables alongside them to add variety without extra effort.
Store components separately so you can mix and match into different meals rather than eating the same bowl every day.
Watch today's video for a full batch-cooking session you can adapt with plant-based staples.
